disclaimer.p2: 2. Heartbeat Protocol: Hacker and Startup tiers require periodic connections to api.dr-os.io for validation. If offline for over 24 hours, the LLM stream will be completely locked. If your environment is 100% offline, you must procure the Air-Gapped Enterprise tier.
disclaimer.p3: 3. No Refunds on Burned Keys: Any attempt to decompile or tamper with the vajra_claw.dll/.so binaries to circumvent UUID restrictions will permanently destroy your License Key without a refund.
